condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Medical condition to search for (e.g. "oncology", "type 2 diabetes"). Leave blank to skip.

sponsor.title: Sponsor
sponsor.description: Lead sponsor organization name (e.g. "Pfizer"). Leave blank for all sponsors.

status.title: Status
status.description: "New" = recruiting or not-yet-recruiting (the trial-start signal). "Terminated" = terminated, withdrawn, or suspended (the trial-failure signal).

country.title: Country
country.description: Limit to trials with at least one site in this country (e.g. "Germany"). Leave blank for all countries.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, by first-posted date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of trials to return, most recently posted first.
